node.label: peroxisome biogenesis disorder due to PEX5 defect in the PEX7-binding domain
node.definition: Any peroxisome biogenesis disorder due to PEX5 in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the PEX7-binding domain of the PEX5 gene.

mechanism_classes.label: peroxisomal biogenesis / peroxisomal enzyme or transporter defect
